method: Each definition in s13-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations; PayPal and OpenAI are never called by these tests; agent tokens are issued by the operator function into the disposable database. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.

results.mutation: accept the agent principal: a request presenting an agent token is treated as a buyer request
results.error: AssertionError: expected 401 to be 403 // Object.is equality

results.error: AssertionError: expected 401 to be 403 // Object.is equality
